selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: Execute user stories. The service is a screen for one person, so stories add the person, the benefit, and the Given/When/Then checks the requirements do not name.

selections.text: Two questions only: who the stories are about, and how small each story is. The views, the UK clock, the 30-second refresh, and the three containers are already in the approved requirements.

selections.text: One persona, the local reader, who starts the containers and reads the board. Four wide stories: the station pair, all trains now, the refresh, and the three containers.
